summary: Independently verified all five other-reviewer rows. Agree with their claims and duplicate dispositions. No new high or critical findings.

responses.argument: Verified profile_source deduplicates by (uf, sha256) before select_sample excludes representative section keys, and run_compact_sample parses the selected bytes without checking protected aliases. Rerunning the synthetic alias probe selected section 0001 and processed the hash shared with excluded section 0002. This duplicates P6-01.

Verified the reservation commits before Parquet writing and the exception handler neither releases nor reuses it. Rerunning export_probe.py produced the injected writer failure, followed by 'Combined recovery/analysis output budget exhausted' on retry; 25165824 bytes remained reserved with no destination published. This duplicates P6-04.

Verified publication.py hashes only version, shard names, parse_id and config, then returns an existing validated release. Rerunning the identity probe with changed coverage-generation logic produced equal release IDs, different mart logical digests and successful validation for both; the existing store reused its old release. This duplicates P6-03.

Traced len(shards)>1 through materialize_marts to every late_session_row without an overlap test. With the same verified-clock fixture, changing only cross_shard_overlap from false to true changed classifiable cycles, after-17 cycles and share from 1, 1 and 1.0 to null, and readiness from ready to unavailable. Observed counters remain available. All five operational-mart tests passed. The rationale correctly limits this behavior to the operational publication path.

Verified review_original_messages accepts six-field rows and exports fields[0][:10] without timestamp validation. Rerunning the complete synthetic pilot probe saved ID12345678 in naive_device_dates while free_text_exported remained false. This duplicates P6-02.
